claim: Current main preserves the pinned fixture, consumer, workflow and budgets of the historical native run, so its replay-obligation frontier is empty; current native acceptance remains NotEstablished.
claim_boundary: Finite evidence plumbing only. Additive-zero and multiplicative-unit normalization are untouched and their histories remain separate.

comparison.claim_boundary: The explicit form distinguishes these ten cases; no global expressivity or efficiency theorem is claimed.

proposed_word.applicability: historical acceptance is valid and both records use the same repository and declared dependency family
proposed_word.counterexample: main commit differs from the historical run commit while all eleven dependency coordinates agree; forcing replay from commit inequality alone would be overbroad
proposed_word.expansion: verify historical success, compare the eleven declared dependency coordinates in order, retain every differing coordinate in the frontier, and keep current acceptance NotEstablished
proposed_word.input: pinned historical native evidence and a current snapshot of fixture, consumer, workflow and byte/work budgets
proposed_word.output_relation: ContinuityChecked/HistoricalEvidenceReusable with an empty frontier, ReplayRequired/DependencyDrift with an ordered frontier, or a refusal/obstruction
refusal_conditions: historical workflow, case, consumer outcome or native outcome is not successful
proposed_word.residual: an empty frontier proves only pin continuity, not current execution, environment continuity, semantic certificate acceptance, social trust, 0090 coverage, 0092 promotion, arithmetic universality or an M6 filler
proposed_word.role: name the exact finite dependency coordinates that must be revalidated or replayed before historical acceptance can inform a changed current snapshot
proposed_word.witness: eight canonical controls plus one fresh exact and one fresh two-coordinate drift reuse

public_scope: Only public artifact coordinates are serialized; motivations or private narratives for earlier isolation are deliberately outside this record.
